subject.title: refactor(codex): keep projector no-op cases local

question: Should this protected Codex refactor be accepted after a maintainer reviews a redacted after-fix runtime transcript for the preserved no-op, unknown-warning, and malformed-usage paths?
rationale: The change is deliberately behavior-neutral but reorganizes Codex protocol handling, and the protected label requires human ownership while the external real-behavior-proof gate is not yet satisfied.

options.title: Request focused runtime proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted app-server run or runtime logs that directly show the three preserved paths before making the maintainer merge decision.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the focused regression suite as sufficient for this narrow internal refactor, despite the normal external proof gate.

recommendation.title: Request focused runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted app-server run or runtime logs that directly show the three preserved paths before making the maintainer merge decision.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged diagnostics work is the closest established behavior baseline for deciding whether this refactor preserves the intended projector contract.
